Name: HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures - Translation Pack QLS
Author: 17SunAndMoon17
Description:
[center][center][center][size=6][b][color=#FF69B4]HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures - Translation Pack QLS
[/color][/b][/size][size=4][color=#A3A3A3]High-Quality Translations for HimeTarts & Wildflourmods' Retextures[/color][/size][/center]Welcome to the [b]Translation Pack QLS[/b] for the gorgeous "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33472]HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures[/url]" mod by HimeTarts and Wildflourmods! This page offers high-quality translations for the building selection interface, allowing more players to choose their favorite bakery and tea shop styles in their preferred language.
[size=5][b][color=#FF85C1]
About the Base Mod (Created by HimeTarts & Wildflourmods)
[/color][/b][/size]
"[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33472]HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures[/url]" provides stunning new retextures for the original HxW Bakery and Tea Shop buildings, designed to match their winery and upcoming building mods.
[size=4][b]
Base Mod Features:[/b][/size][list][*] [b]Refreshed Designs:[/b] Updates the original HxW Bakery and Tea Shop exteriors with new, improved looks (slightly larger footprint).
[*] [b]11 Color Schemes:[/b] Choose from the original plus 10 additional color palettes for each building.
[*] [b]Auto-Detection:[/b] Automatically works with whichever version of the original HxW building mods you have installed (individual or All-in-One pack).
[*] [b]Flexible Selection:[/b] Change building styles via Robin's build menu (Content Patcher) or using Alternative Textures once placed.
[*] [b]Foliage Support:[/b] Includes automatic compatibility for Vibrant Pastoral Recolor, Earthy Recolor, and Starblue Valley Recolor foliage.
[/list][list]
[size=5][b][color=#FF85C1]Languages Available in this Pack:
[/color][/b][/size]This QLS Pack provides translations for the names and descriptions of the building styles selectable via Content Patcher menus.[/list][list][*]Spanish (es)
[*]Portuguese (pt)
[*]German (de)
[*]French (fr)
[*]Russian (ru)
[*]Japanese (ja)
[*]Korean (ko)
[*]Italian (it)
[*]Chinese (Simplified - zh)
[*]Turkish (tr)
[*]Hungarian (hu)
[/list][color=yellow][i](Note: The base mod's primary language is English. This pack adds the 11 translations listed above for the selectable styles.)
[/i][/color][size=5][b][color=#FF85C1]
Requirements[/color][/b][/size][list][*]The original [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33472]HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures[/url][/b] mod by HimeTarts and Wildflourmods.
[*] [b]ALL dependencies[/b] required by the original "HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures" mod (like Content Patcher, etc.). Please verify these on the original mod page.
[/list][color=orange][b]Ensure the base mod is installed and working correctly *before* adding this translation pack.
[/b][/color][size=5][b][color=#FF85C1]
Installation Instructions
[/color][/b][/size][color=red][b]!! VERY IMPORTANT: YOU MUST INSTALL THE ORIGINAL MOD *FIRST* !!
[/b][/color]Download the original mod here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33472]HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures
[/url][b]
Ensure[/b] you have the original "HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures" mod installed correctly in your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder. The folder containing the original mod is named `HXW Bakery & Tea Shop Retexture`.[list=1][*]Download the desired language file or the full pack from the [b]"Files"[/b] tab of [u][b]THIS PAGE[/b][/u].
[*]Unzip the downloaded file. Inside, you will find a folder named `HXW Bakery & Tea Shop Retexture` which contains an `i18n` subfolder.
[*]Navigate to your main `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder and locate the [b]original[/b] `HXW Bakery & Tea Shop Retexture` folder (verify the name matches exactly!).
[*]Open the folder you extracted from the download ([b]Step 2[/b]). Copy the `i18n` folder found inside it.
[*]Paste this copied `i18n` folder directly into the [b]original mod's folder[/b] (named `HXW Bakery & Tea Shop Retexture`) within your `Mods` directory ([b]Step 3[/b]).
[*]Your operating system [b]WILL ask[/b] if you want to merge the `i18n` folders and/or replace files. You [b][color=red]MUST[/color][/b] select [color=red][b]YES / MERGE / REPLACE ALL[/b][/color] for all prompts. This adds the translation files to the mod's structure.
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI. If using Content Patcher to select styles (e.g., at Robin's), the names and descriptions should now appear in your chosen language (if your game language is set accordingly).

[/list][size=5][b][color=#FF85C1]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][list=1][*] This translation pack only provides translation files (`.json` within the `i18n` structure) for the style names/descriptions.[*] It is designed to be fully compatible with the base "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33472]HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures[/url]" mod.
[*] It does not alter textures or game mechanics and should not conflict with other mods.

[/list][size=5][b][color=#FF85C1]Credits[/color][/b][/size][list][*] Huge thanks and all credit to [b]HimeTarts[/b] and [b]Wildflourmods[/b] for creating the beautiful "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33472]HxW Bakery Tea Shop Retextures[/url]"! Their artistic vision is amazing. [i]Please visit and endorse their original mod!
[/i][*] Translations provided by myself ([b]17SunAndMoon17[/b]) and the collaborative team behind the [b]Translation Pack QLS[/b]. Enjoy the pretty buildings in your language![/list][/center][/center]
